notes: Content is sourced only from this repository's synthesis/ and structured/ trees, which in turn cite the archived Turtle WoW forum. Every claim is labelled with a source tier: staff (Turtle WoW Team, the authority on intent), player, or wiki (community Fandom wiki, least reliable) — staff is preferred over player over wiki, and synthesis/contradictions.md lists where sources disagree. Forum links (viewtopic.php?...) stop resolving after the forum closes on 2026-10-16; the archived post ids and quoted text remain valid in this repository regardless. Nothing on this site is invented: where sources are silent, the relevant playbook or class README says so explicitly under its gaps section rather than guessing.
